integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.haHint: The hub talks to Home Assistant for every device. Use a long-lived access token (HA profile → Security).
integrations.haTokenSet: A token is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
integrations.householdHint: Used for day boundaries, clocks on screens and texts the hub writes without a viewer.
integrations.ownerPhoneHint: e.g. pixel_9 — battery, steps and the notification fallback
integrations.publicUrlHint: Shown on device screens and in pairing QR codes

errors.ha_url_invalid: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://
errors.ha_missing: Enter the Home Assistant URL and token first
errors.ha_unreachable: Home Assistant did not answer at that address
errors.forbidden: Only the home owner can change this
errors.key_pinned: The master key is pinned by the environment.

integrations.securityHint: Stored secrets (tokens, SSH keys, 2FA) are encrypted with a master key kept next to the database. Back up both together.
integrations.keyPinned: The master key is set by VMUI_MASTER_KEY in the environment; rotate it there.
integrations.rotateConfirm: Generate a new key and re-encrypt every secret? Old backups need the old key.
integrations.rotated: New master key in place · {rows} secrets re-encrypted

house.title: House
house.summary: {rooms, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} · {devices, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}
house.roomsHint: Rooms decide who sees and controls what (family grants).
house.devicesHint: Each device points at a Home Assistant entity and sits in one room.
house.roomNotEmpty: Move or remove its devices first
house.importHint: Adds HA areas as rooms and their devices. Existing rooms and devices are kept as they are.
house.previewResult: {rooms, plural, =0 {No new rooms} one {# new room} other {# new rooms}}, {devices, plural, =0 {no new devices} one {# new device} other {# new devices}}
